measure.select:
SELECT GEOID10 AS tract, CF || ', ' || SF AS place, CAST(CC AS INTEGER) AS categories, CAST(TPF AS INTEGER) AS population, CASE WHEN SN_C = 1 THEN 'Disadvantaged' ELSE 'Not disadvantaged' END AS status, TRIM(
  CASE WHEN N_CLT = 1 THEN 'Climate change, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN N_ENY = 1 THEN 'Energy, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN N_HLTH = 1 THEN 'Health, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN N_HSG = 1 THEN 'Housing, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN N_PLN = 1 THEN 'Legacy pollution, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN N_TRN = 1 THEN 'Transportation, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN N_WTR = 1 THEN 'Water and wastewater, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN N_WKFC = 1 THEN 'Workforce development, ' ELSE '' END, ', ') AS burdens,
TRIM(
  CASE WHEN CAST(EAL_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Agriculture loss, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(EBL_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Building loss, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(EPL_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Population loss, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(FLD_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Flood risk, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(WFR_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Wildfire risk, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(EB_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Energy cost, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(PM25_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'PM2.5 in the air, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(A_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Asthma, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(DB_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Diabetes, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(HD_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Heart disease, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(LLE_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Low life expectancy, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(HRS_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Historic underinvestment, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(HB_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Housing cost, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(IS_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Lack of green space, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(KP_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Lack of indoor plumbing, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(LPP_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Lead paint, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(AML_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Abandoned mine land, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(FUDS_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Formerly used defense sites, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(TSDF_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Hazardous waste facilities, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(NPL_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Superfund sites, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(RMP_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Risk Management Plan facilities, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(DS_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Diesel particulate matter, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(TD_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Transportation barriers, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(TP_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Traffic proximity and volume, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(UST_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Leaking underground storage tanks, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(WD_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Wastewater discharge, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(LISO_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Linguistic isolation, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(LMI_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Low median income, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(POV_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Poverty, ' ELSE '' END ||
  CASE WHEN CAST(UN_ET AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Unemployment, ' ELSE '' END ||
  '', ', ') AS indicators,
CAST(ROUND(P200_I_PFS * 100) AS INTEGER) AS low_income_pctile, CASE WHEN SN_T = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE NULL END AS tribal, Geometry FROM usa

burdens.label: Burdens
burdens.explainer: A tract is disadvantaged if it is low income and over the threshold in at least one of eight burden categories (or is mostly tribal land).

Climate change.description: In the top 10% nationally for expected losses to farms, buildings or people from natural hazards, or for flood or wildfire risk, and low income.

Energy.description: In the top 10% for household energy costs or fine-particle (PM2.5) air pollution, and low income.

Health.description: In the top 10% for asthma, diabetes or heart disease, or for low life expectancy, and low income.

Housing.description: Historically redlined, or in the top 10% for housing costs, lack of green space, homes without indoor plumbing, or lead-paint risk, and low income.

Legacy pollution.description: Has abandoned mine land or a former military site, or is in the top 10% for nearness to hazardous waste, Superfund or high-risk chemical facilities, and low income.

Transportation.description: In the top 10% for diesel exhaust, barriers to getting around, or heavy nearby traffic, and low income.

Water and wastewater.description: In the top 10% for leaking underground storage tanks or wastewater discharge, and low income.

Workforce development.description: In the top 10% for language isolation, low median income, poverty or unemployment, and more than 10% of adults lack a high school diploma.

indicators.label: Indicators over the threshold
indicators.explainer: The specific measures where this tract is in the top 10% nationally. A burden counts only when the tract is also low income.

Agriculture loss.description: Expected yearly crop and livestock losses from natural hazards, as a share of the area's agricultural value.

Building loss.description: Expected yearly building damage from natural hazards, as a share of building value.

Population loss.description: Expected yearly deaths and injuries from natural hazards, relative to population.

Flood risk.description: Share of properties at risk of flooding within 30 years.

Wildfire risk.description: Share of properties at risk of wildfire within 30 years.

Energy cost.description: Average yearly energy bills as a share of household income.

PM2.5 in the air.description: Fine particulate matter in the air, a pollutant tied to heart and lung disease.

Asthma.description: Share of adults who currently have asthma.

Diabetes.description: Share of adults diagnosed with diabetes.

Heart disease.description: Share of adults with coronary heart disease.

Low life expectancy.description: Average life expectancy is among the lowest in the country.

Historic underinvestment.description: The area was graded hazardous or declining on 1930s federal redlining maps.

Housing cost.description: Share of low-income households spending more than 30% of income on housing.

Lack of green space.description: Share of land covered by pavement, buildings or crops instead of trees and grass.

Lack of indoor plumbing.description: Share of homes without a full kitchen or indoor plumbing.

Lead paint.description: Share of homes built before 1960, which may contain lead paint, where home values are not high.

Formerly used defense sites.description: Contains a former military site that may still be contaminated.

Hazardous waste facilities.description: How close and how many hazardous waste facilities are nearby.

Superfund sites.description: How close and how many Superfund (National Priorities List) sites are nearby.

Risk Management Plan facilities.description: How close and how many facilities that handle dangerous chemicals are nearby.

Diesel particulate matter.description: Diesel exhaust in the air, mostly from trucks, buses and equipment.

Transportation barriers.description: How hard it is to get around: travel cost, time and access to options like transit.

Traffic proximity and volume.description: How many vehicles pass on major roads nearby.

Leaking underground storage tanks.description: How many leaking fuel tanks are nearby.

Wastewater discharge.description: Toxic chemicals discharged into nearby streams.

Linguistic isolation.description: Share of households where no one over 14 speaks English very well.

Low median income.description: Median household income compared with the surrounding area's.

Poverty.description: Share of people below the federal poverty line.

Unemployment.description: Share of the labor force without a job.

low_income_pctile.label: Low income (percentile)
low_income_pctile.explainer: Share of people in households below twice the federal poverty line, not counting college students, ranked nationally. Tracts at or above the 65th percentile meet the low-income test.
